HISTORICAL CARD CORRECTION: the confirmed selected entry mujoco_ur_rl_ros2.envs.ur_reach_env:URReachEnv is a Gymnasium environment, so this package uses GymnasiumDriver for cap.world.step.v1, cap.world.reset.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1. Its six normalized actions in [-1,1] and 15-number observation match pinned ur_reach_env.py:55-79. These copied space declarations are sourced; placeholder state and transition values are not device facts or sourced limits. The fake is an analytic seeded F0 stand-in, has no physics timestep or wall-clock pacing, uses the upstream info key dist, and discloses its approximate state/reward and absent termination, contacts, gripper and rendering dynamics. The simulated R0 software e-stop latches subsequent steps; it does not reset the episode or resample the target, and it does not physically preempt an in-flight step.

The explicit sim backend .sim:make_env requires upstream_root pointing to the pinned repository. It verifies five eagerly imported source files against the pin, supplies the subproject's top-level envs import context temporarily, rejects a foreign cached envs or envs.ur_reach_env module, and constructs URReachEnv with render_mode forwarded. Missing source, dependencies or Menagerie assets fail; there is no fallback fake. Dependencies are numpy, gymnasium, a compatible mujoco with MjSpec and stable_baselines3; external Menagerie XMLs and their assets are required. No version compatibility or external asset fidelity was validated. fidelity_by_backend keeps fake F0 metadata separate from the sim MuJoCo F1 deployment declaration. The factory exposes the constructed model's physics timestep as dt and preserves upstream _dt as the five-substep control period. One cap.world.step tick invokes one native control action; the unresolved SDK/profile/binding/receipt timing consistency is recorded as L14 in the private completion ledger rather than claimed solved. No snapshots, pacing or hardware calibration are claimed.

The fake gate passed G1-G9; its stable digest is current. Expected warnings remain G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for the deferred seed and four G8.NO_UNIT warnings for simulator inputs; no G4.REF_VALUE or G4.REF_BINARY warning occurs. The six package tests include the gate and source-shape, seed, rejection and latch cases; the latch case now asserts episode observation/tick remain unchanged. Ten private deterministic tests used synthetic modules/assets to verify actual factory selection, constructor option forwarding, dynamic timing, distinct backend metadata and explicit failures; they did not import or execute upstream code. The first private test run exposed the SDK's reserved .native hardware-module rule; the factory was moved to .sim and the rerun passed. Other confirmed environment classes, ROS policy nodes, MoveIt, Gazebo, RL training and physical arm interfaces remain outside this selected environment package.
